snippet.title: Wavertree Mountain: Gameplay Trailer | Indie MMORPG on Steam
snippet.description:
Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4725370/Wavertree_Mountain/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trailer

The humans are gone, and no creature alive knows why. Centuries later, six species have made the ruins of the old world their home, and two factions are fighting over what's left of it. Pick a side, dig a burrow of your own, and decide what kind of creature you want to be.

In this trailer:
- Fighting spiders with blocks and abilities
- Character creation: species, fur color and pattern
- Taking on missions, gathering plants and learning new skills
- Digging out a burrow and laying a stone floor
- New gear that shows on your character
- Fishing off the beach
- Checking the mail and sleeping until dawn

Features:
- Six playable species across two factions: the Warren Compact (Mouse, Squirrel, Chipmunk) and the Ashborne League (Rat, Lizard, Gerbil), each species with abilities of its own
- Dig and furnish your own burrow, then tunnel out to your faction's outposts
- Peaceful Mode: the island's creatures won't start fights with you
- Earn reputation with your faction to unlock faction abilities
- Claim outposts and hold them through PvP skirmishes and sieges, or settle scores in duels and guild vs guild battles
- Farm, fish, cook, craft and trade. You can play as a pacifist and still thrive
- Instanced dungeons in every zone, raids of up to 24, and hundreds of missions
- Hundreds of players on each server

One purchase. No subscription. No pay-to-win.
Aiming to launch December 2026.

Follow along:
Website: https://www.wavertreemountain.com
Dev blog: https://www.wazzamouse.com/#devblog
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/wavertreemountain/
Discord: https://discord.gg/VCwFAwWeFv
X: https://x.com/wavertreemtn
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/WavertreeMountain
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/wavertreemountain
